goal: One genuinely trained scoring family improves both-positive SugarCrepe++ while retaining both full-gallery e-ViL retrieval directions on both encoders.

model.trainable: last text transformer block and final text layer normalization
model.frozen: image encoder/features, tokenizer, token embeddings, positional embeddings, first eleven text blocks, text projection, reference last block and normalization
model.base: float64 dot product of original float32-normalized cached image/text features
model.initialization: learned and reference last blocks have identical pretrained tensors; paired identical arithmetic yields an exactly zero initial correction
model.reference_autograd: Reference flags match learned flags for identical CPU kernels; reference output is detached, no reference gradients flow, and reference parameters are excluded from optimizer.
model.routing: same score for every image-text pair, without task labels or gallery-dependent policy
model.text_batch_policy: each requested unique caption is length-sorted with cache-index tie break, encoded once in deterministic batches of64, and reused in both retrieval directions
model.prefix_policy: float32 first-eleven-block activations, train/validation/dev900 only; exact pretrained weight hashes and cache member hashes are bound
model.visual_inputs: existing frozen image feature archives; no new raw images

development.composition_objective: For each source-supported-contradicted triplet, logsumexp of zero and the two negative-minus-positive margin violations. Average triplets within image, then average images; neither positive is treated as equivalent to the other.
development.neutral_policy: Never label neutral hypotheses as contradictions.
development.retrieval_objective: Source-caption-only bidirectional retrieval plus preservation of positive frozen margins against training hard negatives.
development.selection: Require genuinely nonzero training and no development R1 loss in either direction; maximize image-averaged fraction of source-supported-contradicted triplets where both positives beat the contradiction. Final seed/configuration selection is frozen before new test scoring.
development.retrieval_ties: Descending float64 score, then ascending gallery manifest index; same rule as the prior primary endpoint.

continuation_rule: Any extension or new pilot configuration requires a distinct protocol amendment recorded before that run; no current held-out outcomes may guide this decision.

test_lock.required: Both encoders and all three selected seeds, exact checkpoint hashes, model/source/input hashes, and the selection rule are bound before any new test scoring.
test_lock.historical_test_use: Prior study test results informed this new scientific hypothesis; current evaluations cannot be called pristine confirmatory tests.

practical_gate.caption_endpoint: SugarCrepe++ both positive captions strictly outrank negative
practical_gate.secondary_retrieval: COCO Karpathy5k full galleries, both directions
practical_gate.bootstrap_unit: paired image clusters, averaging the three fitted seeds
practical_gate.retrieval_ties: Descending float64 score, then ascending gallery manifest index

preservation: Save epoch0 and every nonzero epoch checkpoint, optimizer state, raw development predictions, immutable ledger, history, selection, and completion receipt.
amendment_reason: Matching RN50 pilot passed its predeclared development feasibility condition, enabling unchanged29/43replications for both encoders.

conditional_replication_authorization.condition: RN50 has at least one nonzero epoch with positive development composition gain and no loss in either development retrieval direction
conditional_replication_authorization.hyperparameters: unchanged four-epoch configuration; sequential runs with at most three threads total
conditional_replication_authorization.held_out_policy: Both pooled and token three-seed selections must be locked before any held-out outcome scoring.

canonical_selection_note: Batched development results are screening only. Final three-seed epoch selections require separate gallery-independent single-caption prefix and suffix canonical development rescoring before both-family test lock.
